html5: Welcome to Mars! You are in charge of a base with {crew} astronauts. Your goal:
html6: keep your crew safe and the base running
html7: . Each day on Mars is called a sol. Make smart choices together, one sol at a time!
html8: Look after oxygen, water, radiation shielding, energy and food. Each sol brings one or two cards. Choose what to do, then see how your choice changes the base.
html10: Or swipe left or right to begin.
html16: The crew stops here. You can start a new mission after.
storageUnavailable: Progress cannot be saved in this browser.
changedTab: Your mission changed in another tab. Load the latest progress?
mockNote: Test card: these numbers are not real.
completeBody: You did it, Captain! You kept your crew safe and the base running for {totalSols} sols on Mars. Your choices helped your team complete the mission. Your crew is proud of you!
endedBody: You ended the mission on Sol {sol}.
invalidSave: Your saved mission cannot be loaded. Start a new mission to replace it.
briefingImageAlt: An imagined Mars base with habitats, a rover and astronauts on the orange surface
tabletEmpty: All clear, Captain! No active effects right now.
resourceLose: After 1 sol, you will have {amount} {unit} less.
resourceGain: After 1 sol, you will have {amount} {unit} more.
resourceSteady: After 1 sol, this amount will stay the same.
difficultyIntro: Your crew is ready. Choose your mission: tap or swipe left for Operation Steins or right for Operation Gate
difficultyEasyHint: Calling all new scientists! Keep your crew safe for {easySols} sols. Start with supplies at 75 and easier cards.
difficultyHardHint: Ready, brave astronauts? Keep your crew safe for {hardSols} sols. Start with half your supplies and trickier choices.
resourceLoseEasy: After 1 sol, this number will go down by {amount}.
resourceGainEasy: After 1 sol, this number will go up by {amount}.
failedBody-life-support: Life Support ran out. Your crew needs both oxygen to breathe and water to drink. The mission must stop.
failedBody-oxygen: The oxygen supply ran out. Your crew needs oxygen to breathe. The mission must stop.
failedBody-water: The water supply ran out. Your crew needs water to drink and run the base. The mission must stop.
failedBody-shield: The shelter has no radiation shielding left. Your crew cannot stay safely. The mission must stop.
failedBody-energy: The energy supply ran out. The base cannot keep its machines running. The mission must stop.
failedBody-food: The food supply ran out. Your crew needs food to keep going. The mission must stop.
dailyCostHint: Choose one resource to use {dailyCostMultiplier}× faster. Production stays the same. Shield has no daily use.
creditsProject: Mission: Perseverance — an educational Mars mission game.

tutorialCardBody: Each choice has a trade-off: it can help one supply but use another. Tap a choice, or swipe left or right.
tutorialEffectsBody: Lasting effects and planned changes appear here. Hover or tap an icon to see its changes per sol, or when it happens.
tutorialRadiationBody: Radiation is energy that travels as waves or tiny particles. Some kinds can harm astronauts.
